_comment: Identity and packaging for ONE role: what the client sees (name and face)
and what the role needs to work (skills, connections, keys).
THE NAME AND FACE SHIP PRESET on purpose. Hiring a role has to be one click:
opening a character editor before the agent does anything puts an aesthetic
decision in front of the value.
THIS ONE SHIPS NO CRAFT SKILL, AND THAT IS THE DESIGN. The four skills below
are the plumbing every role carries; its hands are the `level: base`
capabilities every agent already has (see `capabilities`). What it can do
beyond that is whatever the client picks from the capability menu at hire
time -- the role does not grow by itself, and the agent never installs
anything: the `capability` skill's card is the only way in.
`look` are the character axes from app/app/lib/agentito.tsx (tone, antenna,
accessory, pupil, mouth, skin, suit, brows). Each role starts at a CLEARLY
different point in that space: the face is how you tell who did what in a
list of twenty cards. This one takes the plain antenna and the freckles,
both unused by the four craft roles.

env_requires.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env_requires.description: Transcribes the audio and reads the images the client sends
